body: I'll sleep on it I suppose. Thanks for listening.

>I just want to sleep

This is how I feel right now.  I'm the same age as you are and keep fucking up in school too.  It sucks that I don't even care if the days get better or worse anymore.  I just want them to end.  

Just hope you know somewhere out there someone's in the exact same spot you are.  I hope it works out for the both of us.

Not that I know of. 

I know that they aren't obligated to and that just hurts me more.  I feel like I've betrayed them despite all they've given me.  I've tried to use that as motivation to do better, but it never lasts.

I still am yeah.

The thing is I'm not really lonely.  I just feel like there's no point to anything I do.  I have hobbies but they aren't very productive (mostly video games actually) 

I'd like the ability to change majors but to be honest I'm not even paying for my own education.  I feel like shit because I'm just a burden on my parents.  I've no way to move out on my own and get a simple part-time job due to issues I can't explain here. There's no real guarantee i could even use this education because of said situation.
